mapper.select: SELECT campus_code, period_type, window_start_at, window_end_at, generated_at, rules_snapshot, items FROM restaurant_ranking_snapshots WHERE campus_code = #{campusCode} AND period_type = #{periodType}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO restaurant_ranking_snapshots (campus_code, period_type, window_start_at, window_end_at, generated_at, rules_snapshot, items) VALUES (#{row.campusCode}, #{row.periodType}, #{row.windowStartAt}, #{row.windowEndAt}, #{row.generatedAt}, #{row.rulesSnapshot}, #{row.items}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE window_start_at = VALUES(window_start_at), window_end_at = VALUES(window_end_at), generated_at = VALUES(generated_at), rules_snapshot = VALUES(rules_snapshot), items = VALUES(items)
